download_dataset_by_uid: download a habitat-sim dataset by its unique ID using the datasets_download CLI tool
clean_dataset_data: clean and remove downloaded dataset files for a specific data source UID
list_available_datasources: list all available dataset UIDs and data groups using the datasets_download CLI
clone_git_repo_source: clone a git-hosted dataset repository with optional LFS pruning and authentication support
download_and_replace_existing: download a dataset and automatically replace existing versions without user prompts
